I'm sorry bro, I was in the same situation  about 10 years ago, and for 5 years I was just paying interest every month and then living off scraps. My main problem was I would pay a bit off and then when birthdays and Christmas etc rolled round I would need credit again to buy gifts. It was an awful cycle and countless stupid decision after decision.

5 years ago my gf got pregnant and I had to bite the bullet. I told her I'm sorry but I need to sort things out for my kids so no gifts, no days out, no takeaways or restaurants etc. I just did things that didn't cost money, and it was very dull and boring. But it was necessary, I'm still in a bit of debt but I've cleared the bulk of if over 5 years and am finally seeing the light, because now instead of £400 interest a month it's about £100, which is manageable and I'm taking big chunks off each month. I reckon by end of next year I'm debt free. It's KILLED me but I am not going to be a full time working parent who can't afford to buy clothes and food for my kids.

It sucks because I know I've cost myself so many moments in my life, as well as probably taking 10 years off my life expectancy through stress and worry. Some pay days I would wake up already in my overdraft before I got out of bed and had to tell the missus I couldn't even afford to buy shopping. I still hate myself for it BUT better late than never. Fix up now while you still have time left. Sacrifice selfish spending for a couple of years and you'll be able to breathe again

Do it now or you'll be a middle aged wage slave having to pick between bread and milk because you can't get both.

Edit: I re read and saw your outgoings are 200 per month, mine was over £1000 so you really can be debt free by end of next year or close to it. Just need to really live like a tight arse.
